classification_definitions.CHECKPOINT: complete algorithm or process restoration state; none found in this archive
classification_definitions.GENERATED_DATA: new regenerable outputs; archive contains old generated results now frozen as fixture
classification_definitions.DUPLICATE: byte duplicate content, orthogonal to experiment role; distinct original paths retained
classification_definitions.UNVERIFIED: no unverified archive member after size/SHA/schema checks
